root_cause: The eight-query canonical Google News radar correctly recognized an empty task 40101, but incorrectly classified equally empty DataForSEO task 40102 (overall success 20000) as a provider fault and appended it to error logs.
prevention_rule: Classify only 40101 and 40102 as no-results when both HTTP and top-level provider response succeeded; do not mark a source eligible or treat an empty SERP as an original story. All other provider statuses fail closed. Keep existing eight provider query slots and source freshness/uniqueness checks.
